resources.string: Real-time UV index with surface-specific exposure analysis
UV Tracker uses your GPS location to fetch precise UV index data from the Open-Meteo weather API. UV levels vary significantly with latitude, altitude, and local cloud cover.

How much UV actually reaches your skin in each setting

Burn times are estimates for Fitzpatrick skin Type II (fair skin, blue/green eyes). Darker skin tones take significantly longer to burn but UV damage still accumulates. Always use SPF 30+ regardless of skin type.
